 News Outbreak Festival Announces 2027 Lineup Curated By Hayley Williams
 DC By Danielle Chelosky 5:05 PM EST on November 16, 2026 
 Add Stereogum to Google Outbreak Festival has become one of the most reliable hardcore festivals in the UK since it was founded in 2011. Over the years, they've incorporated other genres into the mix while maintaining its focus on hardcore. This year, though, they're switching things up. The festival handed the reins over to Hayley Williams for the lineup, and she put together an eclectic roster with acts like Dinosaur Jr., Blood Orange, American Football, Julien Baker, Rico Nasty, and many more.
 Williams herself will be headlining with "The Hayley Williams Show." The rest of the lineup has Wednesday, Mannequin Pussy, Failure, Bren Lukens, ear, feeble little horse, Drug Church, Drain, Mary In The Junkyard, Soul Glo, Piss, Snooper, Angel Du$t, Sweet Pill, Spiritual Cramp, Citizen, Dev Lemons, Lime Garden, Chalk, JeJune, First Day Back, Reclus.É, Appleseed, Rival Schools, Emma Ogier, H2O, Holder, and Empty Shell Casing, plus more performers to be announced.
 It's not without hardcore — Drain, Soul Glo, Angel Du$t, Drug Church, Piss, Holder, and Empty Shell Casing are right there — but diehards are still disappointed. Nevertheless, the festival goes down next year on June 19 and 20 at Manchester's B.E.C. Arena. A portion of proceeds from every ticket will be donated to Medical Aid For Palestinians , Not A Phase , and Manchester Central Foodbank . Presale goes live on Nov. 18 at 10 a.m. GMT here and general sale on Nov. 19 at 10 a.m. GMT here .
